name: Long-Exposure Light Trails
summary: Night photography with the shutter held open: metrics are teal light trails racing to the vanishing point, and one coral trail swerves out of its lane on the record.
look: A dark navy highway converging on a vanishing point, overhead gantry signs and a shutter HUD. Metrics are glowing tubes (blurred wide stroke plus sharp core); the anomaly is a coral trail that leaves its lane in broken dashes, and the end card is the whole exposure frozen as a white-bordered print.

components.name: Perspective road
components.role: lane lines converging on a vanishing point on deep navy; the stream

components.role: SVG paths with blurred wide stroke plus sharp core; healthy metrics

components.role: overhead lane signs labelled with metric names; also the reveal lockup

motion.how: stroke-dashoffset with gradient-masked head and fading tail; one new streak per beat at 120 BPM

motion.name: Warp speed-up

motion.name: Shutter close
motion.how: black iris wipes in on a downbeat (0.25 s) and the trails freeze as a still

story: Hook: dashboard gantries (DASH 32–38) rush toward camera with the shutter closed, nothing recorded: 'How many dashboards did you check today?'. Reveal: on the drop the shutter opens, teal trails shoot out of the vanishing point and an overhead sign carries the Acme mark and 'Acme Pulse'. Proof: trails flow under lane signs Signups, Active users, p95 212 ms and Checkout; at 09:42 the checkout trail swerves out in coral dashes and a card reads 'Checkout conversion −18% · since 09:42 · after deploy #2231' with Roll back. CTA: an iris closes, the exposure freezes as a print '09:44 · caught on record', then 'Every metric. Every minute.' and Start free.
adapt: Name the lanes after your own streams (orders, builds, API routes, regions) and let the aberrant trail be the thing your product catches.

fit.risk: The synthwave neon-highway cliché; stay restrained with navy, teal and coral only, no pink or purple.
